ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is an interrelation diagram of the main constituent elements of the land environment. “Hydrology” can be seen on the left, “landform” at the lower left, “climate” above, “soil” on the right, and “organisms” at the lower right. The connection between “hydrology” and “landform” in the figure is marked as ⑥. Then reason: The typical geomorphic features of the Loess Plateau are thousands of gullies and ravines, with gullies crisscrossing, mainly shaped by hydrological actions such as running-water erosion and runoff incision. Therefore it corresponds to the connection from hydrology to landform in the figure, and the code is ⑥.

method.method_draft: 先读图识别各环境要素的位置：左侧是“水文”，左下是“地貌”，两者之间的联系标注为⑥。再读题干关键词“塑造了黄土高原的地貌特征”。黄土高原典型的千沟万壑、沟壑纵横地貌主要由流水侵蚀、径流切割形成，属于水文过程对地貌的塑造作用。因此在图中应选表示“水文—地貌”联系的代号⑥。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是陆地环境主要构成要素相互关联图，能看到“水文”在左侧，“地貌”在左下方，“气候”在上方，“土壤”在右侧，“生物”在右下方。图中“水文”和“地貌”之间的联系标注为⑥。再推理：黄土高原的典型地貌特征是千沟万壑、沟壑纵横，主要由流水侵蚀、径流切割等水文作用塑造。因此对应图中水文对地貌的联系，代号为⑥。
